title: State of Punjab through CBI v. Jagtar Singh Hawara & Ors. (Beant Singh Assassination)
crime_type: Human Explosive Vest Detonation / Political Assassination / RDX Secretariat Blast
court_or_authority: Supreme Court of India / High Court of Punjab & Haryana
source: Supreme Court of India Judgment & Indian Kanoon
location: Punjab Civil Secretariat, Sector 1, Chandigarh, India
evidence: Forensic reconstruction of body fragments of Dilawar Singh strapped with RDX belt detonating at 5:07 PM
Ambassador car with fake VIP pass parked in secretariat VIP parking lot
Seizure of high-grade plastic explosive blocks, electrical wire detonators, and cyanide vials from Patiala hideouts
Confession of co-accused detailing military-style briefing and assignment of primary and backup suicide bombers
modus_operandi: Infiltrated state civil secretariat using serving police personnel credentials. Operative Dilawar Singh strapped an RDX explosive belt under his uniform. As Chief Minister Beant Singh entered his bulletproof official car, the operative approached and detonated the explosive, killing the Chief Minister and 16 security personnel.
personality_disorder: Fanatical insurgent indoctrination, willingness for self-immolation, and complete tactical compartmentalization.
common_traits: Insider infiltration using active police credentials
Body-worn RDX explosive belt with manual toggle trigger
Parallel deployment of primary and backup human bombers
summary: High-profile assassination of Punjab Chief Minister Beant Singh. Supreme Court and High Court affirmed capital punishment and whole-life sentences, setting legal standards for high-security blast site forensic reconstruction.
